name: tooltip
purpose: Short text hint for a trigger that meets WCAG 1.4.13: shown after a delay on pointer hover and immediately on keyboard focus, hoverable, dismissible with Escape without moving focus, and referenced from the trigger by aria-describedby (or aria-labelledby for icon-only controls).
whenToUse: Supplementary hints: keyboard shortcuts, the full text of a truncated label, the purpose of an icon-only button.
Naming an icon-only control visually as well as programmatically (relation 'label').
whenNotToUse: Essential information or instructions: touch users never see tooltips; put it on the page.
Validation errors: use the field's validation message.
Long text: tooltips are capped at tooltip-max-width; use Popover or inline help.
responsive: Width up to min(tooltip-max-width, 100vw - 1rem); text wraps. The positioning engine flips and shifts to stay in the viewport.
rtl: `start`/`end` placements are logical and mirror in RTL (direction option or global direction).
theme: Inverse surface (color-inverse, color-on-inverse), radius-sm, shadow-md, font-size-sm. Forced-colors mode draws a CanvasText border.
security: Content is text only (textContent). CSP-safe: positioning uses the CSSOM.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: One visible tooltip at a time by design; instances attach five listeners to the trigger and two to the tooltip.

limitations: Touch pointers never show the tooltip; tooltips must not hold essential information.
Disabled native buttons receive no pointer or focus events, so their tooltips never show; use aria-disabled instead.
Only one tooltip is visible at a time per loaded copy of the module.
The tooltip is appended to the end of the body, or to the trigger's enclosing <dialog> so it stays hoverable while a modal dialog makes the rest of the page inert.
The gap between trigger and tooltip is fixed at 6px.
unsupported: Showing on tap or long press.
antiPatterns: Putting instructions or error messages only in a tooltip.
Using relation 'label' on a control that already has visible text (the tooltip would replace its name).
Tooltips on non-focusable elements: keyboard users cannot reach them.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/tooltip: AuiTooltip directive ([auiTooltip]) on the trigger; auiTooltip binds the content.
